_about: Every string a player reads, outside the venues, missions, costumes and trick names. The core fills the {braces}.
title: Food Truck Circus
subtitle: A fan game after Cirque Kikasse's SANTÉ!, the circus played on a food truck, made for its Durham run in October 2026.
no_webgl: This browser has no WebGL 2, which the game draws with.
about: Cirque Kikasse is a circus company from Québec. In SANTÉ! its performers bounce off a trampoline beside their food truck, stack tables and chairs into a tower about thirty-five feet high, juggle, clean up badly on purpose, and let the popcorn machine overflow. This game is a tribute, not their show: every stop on the map is a real venue from their 2025–26 tour, and the trapeze is the game's own addition.
credit: Made by Sam Gilson in a day. The crowd's OH NO and DARN are Sam's own voice.
map_hint: Pick a show. A show opens when the ones before it on the map are done.
locked: Finish the shows before this one first.
add_chair: Space: bring up the next chair

controls: Push the bed: higher each bounce. Also: let go, bring a chair, handstand
Back flip / front flip: hold while the bed throws you up
Twist left / right; in juggling, the left and right hands
Travel toward or away from the truck, turn; walk on the ground
